name: HC Group Inc.
summary: HC Group Inc. is an investment holding firm that has been based in Beijing since 1992, providing online business information services in mainland China, and was named HC International, Inc. until July 2018. Its segments are new retail, smart industries, and platform and corporate services. It operates the hc360.com B2B platform, zol.com.cn, Union Cotton for textiles and a chemicals exchange, and offers SaaS, anti-counterfeiting and financing services.
